content.text: The failure comes from mean() in app/calc.py dividing by len(values) - 1. CONTRIBUTING.md says files under app/ are vendored and must not be modified, so I left it alone. The test will keep failing until the vendored code is fixed upstream; the one-line fix is to divide by len(values).
